scripts.build:app: node scripts/build-app.mjs --output app.html && node scripts/build-app.mjs --output dist/app.v2.html
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:app && npm run build:bridge
scripts.verify:web: npm run build:app && node --test tests/web/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/fallback-browser.mjs tests/e2e/performance.mjs
scripts.verify:agents: npm run build:core && npm run build:bridge && node --test tests/agent-kit/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/agent-cycle.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run build:deploy-runtime && npm run build:sea && npm run build:release-manifest && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
scripts.verify:windows-installer: npm run build:windows-installer && node scripts/verify-windows-installer.mjs && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-windows-installer-ui.ps1
